about: Does a template make a better film for less than the same content asked for as a prompt? Three real upcoming conferences (none Russia-linked; see each form's sources.md) fill the conference-speaker template's form: a big English one with 24 speakers, a small one whose site serves only 128 px photos, and a Ukrainian one. Arm 'template' remakes the template from the form (--mode template); arm 'prompt' is the same content written out as a 30 s prompt with the logo and the five featured photos attached (--mode prompt). The forms and pictures are local (temp/bakeoff/, third-party content). Bars (plan, 2026-09-30): every template film inside the time limit, fidelity >= 4, no sample left over, at least a point more professional than the prompt arm at half its Claude cost or less. The -web prompts give the website alone (template v4, website-first): Claude reads the site, brings in the logo and the speakers' photos and fills the form itself.
